description: This file contains a jQuery plugin implementing timers, function queues, and array-based timer functions. It provides mechanisms for timed callbacks, queued function execution, and array iteration with timing control.

methods.name: fjFunctionQueue
methods.description: Manages a queue of functions, allowing sequential timed execution with callbacks for start and complete events.

methods.name: fjTimer
methods.description: Sets up a Timer with specified interval, number of repeats, and tick callback for timed execution.

methods.name: fjTimerEach
methods.description: Iterates over an array, invoking a callback at each step with timing control.
